idea-plugin.name: Accessibility Statement Lint
idea-plugin.description:
Checks the accessibility statement you already published against the EU model statement and its two dates

Right-click in the editor (or Tools) → Accessibility Statement Lint: Check This File. Each finding appears on its line with the fix. 19 rules, offline. Runs the same engine as the VS Code extension and the CLI: npx @readystack/accessibility-statement-lint (Node.js 18+ required).

Free for the file you open. The whole-project sweep and the report need a licence ($29 once): getreadystack.com/tools/accessibility-statement-lint

action.text: Accessibility Statement Lint: Check This File
action.description: Run Accessibility Statement Lint on the file in the editor
